title: JANUS Linear A formula-transition / neighborhood-role execution result

representation_baseline.meaning: v0.7 does not replace v0.6.2 representation evidence; it consumes the typed candidate universe as a frozen prerequisite.

predeclared_question: After punctuation and numeric literals are typed out of semantic candidate space, does any anonymous local semantic-token neighborhood relation survive relation-destroying nulls, an independent HT confirmation partition, and non-HT cross-region replication?

tested_families.TNT: semantic token -> numeric-like slot -> semantic token

motif_ontology.scope_limit: This result applies only to the tested local TT/TNT motif ontology and the declared frequency thresholds; it does not prove that Linear A lacks longer or differently conditioned formula structure.

CONTROL_INCLUDED.purpose: Positive-control channel in which known accounting/personnel families remain eligible.

NON_HT_REPLICATION.interpretation: The HT-confirmed SA·RA₂ -> GRA motif did not meet the predeclared minimum non-HT support requirements, so no non-HT p-value was generated. This is not classified as a statistical replication failure; it is insufficient cross-region support under the frozen gate.

NOVELTY_MASKED.purpose: Novelty channel with VIR*, KU-RO, KI-RO, PO-TO-KU-RO, and GRA retained as fixed MASK geometry but removed from semantic candidate identity.

partition_discipline.HT_SCREEN: deterministic 3/5 hash partition; exploratory generation only
partition_discipline.HT_CONFIRM: deterministic 2/5 hash partition; independent confirmation with Bonferroni correction
partition_discipline.reason: Earlier JANUS stages touched the full corpus, so this remains a cross-region replication stress test rather than pristine external holdout.

falsification_ledger.path: GRA -> numeric slot -> OLE local formula
falsification_ledger.reason: Strong HT-screen enrichment did not survive Bonferroni-corrected independent HT confirmation.
The screen candidate lacked sufficient support under the frozen confirm eligibility gate.
Bonferroni-confirmed inside independent HT partition, but insufficient non-HT occurrence/document/region support for the predeclared replication test.
After the frozen known-control mask, no motif met the predeclared HT-screen minimum frequency/document eligibility thresholds.

infrastructure_successes: Typed-token v0.6.2 ontology was consumed without relaxing representation gates.
Candidate generation and confirmation were separated into disjoint deterministic HT partitions.
Known controls were masked as fixed geometry rather than deleted, preventing synthetic adjacency.
Semantic identity reveal occurred only after statistical scoring.
The relation-specific null destroyed identity-neighborhood coupling while preserving document-local marginals and slot geometry.
The pipeline distinguished statistical replication failure from non-evaluability due to insufficient cross-region support.

roadmap.goal: Test longer typed formula neighborhoods and numeric-bucket-conditioned motifs without lowering current error-control thresholds.
required_controls: same HT_SCREEN -> HT_CONFIRM -> NON_HT partition discipline

roadmap.goal: Repeat any future survivor using an independent transcription/parser source.
Reimplement the test independently before promotion beyond structural-candidate status.
Only after structural replication, test document behavior, morphology, alternative segmentation, and competing lexical explanations.
